about: Festivals and showcases outside Steam's own calendar, maintained by hand. Steam Next Fest and Steam's themed fests come from window-planner/model.js (WindowModel.EVENTS), so don't add them here. Every entry needs a source URL (the page the dates came from) and the date it was checked; entries without them are not shown. Entries checked more than 90 days ago show a warning that the dates may have changed. Don't add a festival or date you haven't read on its own site.

schema.name: festival or showcase name
schema.url: https link to the festival's page (defaults to source)
schema.submissionCloses: YYYY-MM-DD or empty (the deadline the list sorts by)
schema.cost: free text as the festival states it, e.g. "Free" or "$50 submission fee"
tags: genre tags it accepts; empty means any genre
schema.source: https URL the dates were read from (required)
